_doc: The San Diego freeway network (I-5 / SR-52 / SR-163 / I-8, both carriageways and every ramp; shipped as san_diego_freeway_v0.5.0) through the chain (tools/ship_track.sh; docs/ONE-CHAIN.md §4 row 8, Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild, by an agent'). The draft is the network draft scripts/build_network.sh ran as net -> classify -> elev -> mesh, as chain steps: net (Overpass, source.bbox / highways / refs) -> classify (OSM class, lanes, layer) -> network_elev (3DEP along every edge + the terrain grid) -> network_mesh (data/track.obj: 1ROAD / 1WALL / 1RUNOFF / 1GRASS tiles, flyover decks) -> underlay (data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_*). Never build_network_env: no generated furniture. Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet. The ship phase was written for one-line tracks: the prep (build_kn5_loop.py), write_ai_line, make_map and drive_test read data/centerline.local.json / finished_centerline.json, which a network draft does not write (tracks/san-diego-freeway/README.md 'What the Windows run owes'). Gantries, Mission Bay's water, the Pacific plane and lane-level detail are authoring items, never build_network_env.
